name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B UD-Q4_K_M on one Intel Arc Pro B70

library.summary: Hybrid Mamba MoE (arch nemotron_h_moe, 1M native context) confirmed running on Intel with no NVFP4 runtime; flattest decode-vs-depth curve of the first wave.

featured_metric.label: decode (3B active parameters)
featured_metric.scope: Conventional 99-interval median, cold 12-prompt suite, 512-token responses, target-only, cache-zero; second fresh-server run 72.035976.

context_curve.scope: llama-bench raw engine rates (pp2048/tg128, fa on, 5 reps); only -11% decode from 0 to 32K depth.

contributors.name: neural.download lab
contributors.contribution: Intake verification, bring-up, baselines, depth sweep, operating point, canary battery, package.
contributors.validated_effect: Stock-upstream characterization; no lab patches in this package.

known_limitations: With reasoning ON, repeated identical requests are not hash-stable (thinking-channel sampling); deterministic with reasoning off - the recipe default.
Two-card comparison unlocked but not yet run.
1M native context not exercised beyond 32K here.

runtime.build: cmake -G Ninja -B build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=icpx -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=icx -DGGML_SYCL=ON -DGGML_SYCL_F16=ON -DGGML_SYCL_DEVICE_ARCH=bmg_g31 -DGGML_SYCL_MAX_PARALLEL_LINK_JOBS=32 -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF && cmake --build build-sycl-aot-bmg-g31 --target llama-server llama-bench -j 24

commands.launch: BUILD_DIR/bin/llama-server --model $MODEL_DIR/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --alias nemotron --reasoning off --ctx-size 8192 --cache-type-k f16 --cache-type-v f16 --device SYCL0 --gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn auto --parallel 1 --cache-ram 0 --ctx-checkpoints 0 --fit off --metrics --no-webui --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18100
commands.benchmark: python3 scripts/bench-openai-realistic-suite.py --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18100 --model nemotron --api-mode completions --suite repro/qwen36-27b-autoround-int4-b70/realistic-suite-v1.json --max-tokens 512 --metric-tokens 100 --seed 1 --request-extra-json '{"cache_prompt":false,"seed":42,"temperature":0}' --out bench.json

missing: context beyond 32K of the 1M native window
